manifest.claim_text: Site/device shortcuts is controlled for. Primary metric: Domain calibration, worst-site error and residual site predictability.
manifest.falsified_by: The mandatory control (Leave-site/device/protocol-out evaluation; nuisance-only classifier and label permutation within site) shows the result survives only without it.
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Minimum interpretation enforced: High pooled accuracy with poor new-device calibration is failure
non_goals: This gate does not claim a validated digital twin of any specific person.
This gate does not claim that any admitted operator is neurally realized.
No human stimulation protocol is implemented or implied: this is a deep-learning study on open data and there is no device command path.

blocking_reasons: leave_site_out: could not run — no per-site datasets or model factory supplied; pooled accuracy alone cannot detect a site shortcut
nuisance_only_classifier: could not run — no nuisance features/labels supplied; residual site predictability is unmeasured
within_site_label_permutation: could not run — no permutation scores supplied; without them, an apparent effect cannot be distinguished from site structure

subchecks.name: leave_site_out
subchecks.reason: no per-site datasets or model factory supplied; pooled accuracy alone cannot detect a site shortcut
subchecks.falsified_by: worst-site calibration collapses on a new device

subchecks.name: nuisance_only_classifier
subchecks.description: Can the label be predicted from nuisance (site/device) features alone?
subchecks.reason: no nuisance features/labels supplied; residual site predictability is unmeasured
subchecks.falsified_by: nuisance alone predicts the label above chance

subchecks.name: within_site_label_permutation
subchecks.reason: no permutation scores supplied; without them, an apparent effect cannot be distinguished from site structure
subchecks.falsified_by: permuted-within-site labels are still predicted above chance

known_uninformative_fields.git_dirty_whole_tree: a whole-tree dirty flag always reads dirty during a run, because the run writes tracked output (reports/training/*.log, *.jsonl). It cannot distinguish modified source from a run writing its own log, so it is not recorded here and must not be gated on. Use source_dirty_paths.
